question: Does completed-minute SOXX price displacement from its trailing 15-minute volume-weighted traded-price proxy improve fee-net timing of legal cash-to-SOXX buys beyond matched own-state and ordinary minute returns?
feature_formula: At completed bar t, SOXX raw close and raw volume over the latest 15 completed 1m bars including t. vwap_proxy15=sum(raw_close*raw_volume)/sum(raw_volume), requiring positive volume sum. Added feature log(raw_close/vwap_proxy15). This is a traded-price proxy, not actual exchange VWAP. Feature known no earlier than t+1 minute; label available after next-day09:47 reset at09:49.
first_anchor: For each day use the first funded minute. Base label is its fee-net local advantage. At later funded minutes, delta label is current fee-net local advantage minus that first value; all delta inputs are current available features minus first-available features. At evaluation, combine the same base prediction with each arm delta prediction and trigger on first total predicted fee-net advantage>0. No current-day future mean is used at inference.
model: Qlib DatasetH plus fixed StandardScaler/Ridge alpha10, inverse minute-count day weights. Fit base and control/candidate delta models on strictly prior mature years; 2021 and 2022 evaluation. Six fixed fits total, no seed/window/threshold selection.
information_gate: Both 2021 and 2022 require >=10 candidate funded trigger days, candidate fee-net local value sum>0 and candidate-minus-control sum>0, at least one changed funded trigger time or action day, added standardized coefficient negative as preregistered price-discount/reversion sign, and full-calendar paired 63-day stationary-bootstrap lower mean increment>0. Identical scores or all triggers at first eligible minute are minute_not_transmitted. Only a pass permits one separately frozen full own-state 0bp account.
stop: Any label source hash/clock/maturity/feature coverage failure or information gate failure closes this fixed version. No altering 15m window, sign, Ridge alpha, first-passage threshold, years or action size after results. Historical source NAS archive receipt is missing; preserve its local Recorder and mark evidence needs_nas. Reused 2023+ is not independent.
